meta.title: RetroNet Teams for Corvid Health — sales session, December 2026
meta.description: Sales deck for RetroNet Teams, an open-source tracker-stripping browser layer, written for Corvid Health IT: the tracker shift, winners and losers, three obstacles, hospital proof, rollout plan and price.

slides.eyebrow: Prepared for Corvid Health IT · 3 December 2026
slides.heading: How Corvid Health can browse the web without leaking patient data
slides.notes: Open on their risk, not our product. The product name waits until slide 5.

slides.heading: The median website now loads 41 trackers, over four times 2016
slides.lead: Source: crawl of the top 1,000 sites each January, n = 1,000.

slides.heading: Teams that block trackers in the browser pass audits; others write reports
slides.left:
Staff must remember.
Trackers still fire.
3 incidents a year.
slides.right:
Nothing to remember.
No third-party calls.
Clean audits.

slides.heading: Every Corvid laptop opens the same page with zero trackers attached
slides.lead: Same URL. Same article. Nothing else leaves the building.

slides.heading: RetroNet strips 41 trackers before a page even renders
slides.body: Filtering runs in the browser layer. Clinicians just click.
slides.aside: Nothing to install per user, nothing to remember.

slides.heading: IT rolls out one policy file to 2,400 laptops in an afternoon
slides.code:
[fleet]
seats = 2400
mode = "strict"

[allow]
first_party = true
ehr = "*.corvid.health"

[report]
audit = "weekly"

slides.heading: Clinical forms keep working because first-party code stays
slides.body: Blockers break logins. RetroNet keeps the page's own scripts and drops the rest.
slides.aside: 0.4% of pages needed an exception in pilots.

slides.heading: Proof from a hospital group like yours
slides.lead: Northgate Clinics, 1,900 seats, live since May.

slides.heading: Northgate cut page load by 94% and third-party calls to zero

stats.label: Privacy incidents in six months, was 3

slides.notes: Ask what their own incident count was last year. Let them say the number.

slides.quote: Our audit found zero third-party calls from clinical laptops for the first time.
